text:
Hana (PM): quick thread to nail down DP handshake process + slot rules so we stop triaging by DM. trying to keep ops light but get high-signal partners.
Leo (Eng): agree. infra prefers a steady trickle vs bursts.
Carmen (ProdOps): ops cap suggestion: 6 active DP slots, max 2 high-touch. hold 1 slot as a floating rapid-follow slot.
Devon (Research): signal quality > quantity. prioritize partners who will run scripted evals and share session recordings.
Asha (Design): product coverage ask: aim for search, agents, and embeddings-heavy use cases across the quarter; include at least one early-stage startup.
Hana (PM): draft scoring weights: commitment_prob 30%, strategic_value 25%, fit_with_product_roadmap 20%, feedback_richness 15%, compliance_risk 10%.
Leo (Eng): compliance should route to a private-deploy path if needed; don't auto-exclude. also capture expected p95 latency and session lengths in intake.
Devon (Research): small sheet-friendly formula we can use:
```
score = 0.3*commit + 0.25*strategic + 0.2*fit + 0.15*feedback + 0.1*(1 - risk)
```
Asha (Design): add a soft "infra-exercise" flag for vector DB / streaming / tool-calls to break ties.
Carmen (ProdOps): operational requirements: weekly async check-ins, demo recording every 2 weeks, survey completion >=75%. I'll add these as intake acceptance checks.
notify-bot: reminder created will ping 48h before mid-wave and final reviews. :robot_face:
Hana (PM): promotion gate DP->beta: >=75% engagement rate during the loop, no unresolved infra blockers, and a measurable improvement on a partner success metric (latency, cost, or accuracy).
Carmen (ProdOps): action: I'll update intake + automations and share the link.
Devon (Research): action: I'll build a scoring sheet and include example scores.
Asha (Design): action: I'll map coverage targets and small-team targets.
Leo (Eng): action: adding infra metadata fields to intake now.
Hana (PM): i'll collate into a 1-pager and post in #product tomorrow. target shortlist by next Tue. :thumbsup:
